english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who acts without responsibility or for irresponsible conduct.

examples.english: The way you’re acting is really irresponsible and will drag the whole team down.
examples.traditional: 你咁樣做真係唔負責任，會累到成隊人㗎。
